title: Whitehead's theorem for minimal finite models
summary: We investigate the extent to which Whitehead's theorem remains valid for minimal finite models. We show that it fails in this setting, answering negatively a question posed by Barmak. More precisely, for every $n\geq 2$, we construct a weak homotopy equivalence between two $(2n+4)$-point minimal finite models of $S^n\vee S^{n-1}\vee S^{n-1}$ which are not homotopy equivalent.
